reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Route broad visual missions across identity, systems, logos, presentations, banners, icons, social assets, generation, export, and verification.
neutralIntentExamples: select the smallest visual specialist for an approved mission
coordinate a brand-grounded social-asset production path
inputs: visual objective, brand evidence, placement, assets, rights, and generation authority
operations: classify the mission, select specialists, produce or generate, export, inspect, and organize
outputs: visual deliverables, briefs, and production evidence
failureBehavior: defer unavailable tools, brand evidence, rights, or generation authority

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Generate and prioritize a durable short-form idea portfolio from identity, audience questions, source mining, editorial pillars, repurposing, capacity, and current signals.
neutralIntentExamples: build a source-linked short-form idea matrix for a specific audience
turn one approved topic into several distinct truthful video angles
inputs: identity, audience evidence, approved topics, source material, current signals, and production capacity
operations: derive pillars, mine questions and patterns, expand angles, score ideas, balance evergreen and timely work, and queue production
outputs: prioritized short-form idea portfolio with provenance and production notes
failureBehavior: label weak or unavailable trend evidence and avoid padding the portfolio with duplicates
usefulInvariants: ideas trace to audience or source evidence

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Compose a concise quote or data card from verified content while preserving authorship, brand identity, dimensions, and target-size legibility.
neutralIntentExamples: turn a verified insight into a branded share-card brief
create a legible data card with correct attribution
inputs: verified quote or data, author identity, brand system, and placement dimensions
operations: select card type, compose hierarchy, apply restrained styling, verify attribution, and inspect
failureBehavior: stop when data, authorship, brand, or visual tooling is unresolved

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Plan a multi-touch professional-network outreach campaign across targeting, messages, cadence, account safety, consent, and stopping rules.
neutralIntentExamples: prepare an unpublished professional-network contact sequence from verified relevance
audit a multi-touch campaign for consent, spam, and account-risk boundaries
inputs: authorized audience evidence, sender identity, campaign purpose, current policy, and contact authority
operations: qualify targets, draft messages, sequence finite follow-ups, check account safety, and define stops
outputs: unexecuted outreach campaign and compliance preflight
failureBehavior: stop when relevance, consent, identity, current limits, or sender authority is unresolved
